Maria S: Quick heads-up — Lithos POC timeline just shifted by a week. Need to confirm integration owners, staging access windows, and success criteria so SE handoff stays clean.
Devon L: noted. who from infra needs to be on this? firewall / peering is usually the blocker.
Aisha R: I can own the SSO and API contract side. @Devon can you confirm if we need a dedicated VPC or just peering into their AWS account?
Devon L: For initial trial peering should be fine. If they ask for private deployment later we’ll bump to VPC. Need network CIDR from their infra.
Kevin T: I’ll take ownership of the model integration and can set up a canary route for the trial model variants. Plan: model-v1 (fp16), fallback to model-v1-quant if latency spikes.
Jamie P: Success criteria from sales: 95th p99 latency < 450ms for single-turn queries, 90% accuracy on our eval prompts (they’ll share 100 prompts tomorrow), and seamless SSO flow.
Maria S: Good. Can we list immediate deps: 1) Lithos network CIDR + test creds (Lithos action) 2) SSO test account + SCIM (Lithos) 3) CR review for the SE shim (Redwood) 4) Staging deploy slot (Infra)
Devon L: infra action: pre-allocate staging slot on dedicated-d1, save snapshot for rollback. Will need a CR to change routing: ping me in PR.
Aisha R: SSO note: Lithos uses Okta OIDC. I'll need client_id/secret + a test user with group membership. If they prefer SAML it's more work.
Kevin T: CR ping: @Jamie P can you review the SE shim PR? link: https://git.redwood/SE/lithos-shim/pulls/42
Jamie P: On it, will try to get eyes by EOD. Quick note on sampling: we should include 20 edge-case prompts that exercise long context and 10 with rare tokens.
Maria S: Also bake in observability: token-level cost, p99 latency by route, and a small smoke eval after deploy. Devon, can infra-bot run the smoke job once slot is live?
infra-bot: smoke job queued: lithos-poc-smoke v1. Will report pass/fail to #incidents if failures > 0.
Devon L: infra-bot confirmed. ETA for staging slot: tomorrow 9:00 PT. Jamie — after you approve PR I’ll flip routing and run smoke.
Jamie P: PR approved with minor comment, pushed a small test fix.
Kevin T: after smoke passes I’ll start the canary with 5% traffic for 2 hours, watch latency and error rate. If stable, bump to 100%.
Maria S: Great. Action owners recap: Lithos -> network CIDR + creds + eval prompts; Aisha -> SSO config; Devon -> staging slot + routing; Jamie -> PR review; Kevin -> model canary + evals. Any blocking items?
Aisha R: Waiting on Lithos for Okta app details — asked them this morning.
Jamie P: I have a scheduling conflict tomorrow morning but can review after lunch.
Maria S: Thanks everyone. I’ll update the SE handoff doc and ping Lithos to emphasize the Okta details. Will post final readiness check here once smoke passes. :thumbsup:
